description: Return one app's listing change history, newest first: new versions, icon and screenshot redesigns (visually verified), price and business-model changes, renames, category moves, description rewrites and more, grouped by day. Cost: 1 credit.

before.description: Return only days strictly before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pass the previous response's next_before to page back through the history.
before.title: Before

days.description: How many change days to return, newest first, 1-60 (default 20). A change day groups every field that changed on that date.
days.title: Days

store.description: Which store the store_id belongs to: 'apple' or 'google'.
store.title: Store

store_id.description: Store-native app id without the store prefix: numeric track id for Apple ('284882215'), bundle id for Google ('com.spotify.music').
store_id.title: Store Id

name: get_app_timeline
title: Get app change timeline
